pointQr.title: QR code
pointQr.hint: Download a point image or print all QR codes, one per page (Save as PDF is available in the print dialog). QR codes identify points; login and task permissions are still required.
pointQr.limit: More than 500 points match. Narrow the filters before printing.

pointImport.title: Import points
pointImport.hint: Fill all four columns: category ID, category name, point name and location. See the category reference sheet. XLS/XLSX, up to 1000 rows and 10MB. Validated rows are inserted atomically; existing points are not overwritten and posts are not assigned automatically.
pointImport.fileInvalid: Choose an XLS or XLSX file no larger than 10MB
pointImport.failed: Validation or import failed. Correct the errors and select the file again.

errors.formula: Formulas are not supported; enter literal values
errors.fieldLength: Category or location is too long (location: 255 characters)
errors.duplicate: Duplicate category, point name and location in this file
errors.categoryUnavailable: Category is unavailable or access is denied
errors.categoryMismatch: Category ID and name do not match

Patrol.title: Patrol
Patrol.name: Name
Patrol.rosterOptional: Allow without roster; otherwise enforce shift
Patrol.ruleHint: One task per configured period; count complete frequency cycles. Earlier end times cross midnight, equal times mean 24 hours. Date rules override weekday rules.
Patrol.snapshotHint: Preview does not save tasks. Generated tasks retain snapshots and are not overwritten by plan edits.
Patrol.reportHint: Based on task business dates, up to 31 days. Only accepted executions count; applications and exemptions are excluded.
Patrol.saveFailed: Not saved. Correct the input or retry.
Patrol.referenceHint: Reference notes are for inspection guidance; text equality does not imply a pass.
Patrol.qualifiedHint: Leave empty to disable automatic judgment. Legacy options do not receive an assumed passing value.
Patrol.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5MB per image.
Patrol.itemTitleRequired: Enter an item title (up to 200 characters)
Patrol.invalidOptions: Options must be unique; passing options must belong to the available options
Patrol.invalidLimits: Use up to 18 integer and 6 decimal digits; lower limit must not exceed upper limit
Patrol.levelRuleHint: Use the selected point level rule. Custom rules remain available for existing plans without a level.

statistics.hint: Filter by task creation date. Coverage = completed / expected patrols. Qualification = completed / total task periods, separate from inspection results.
statistics.peopleHint: Aggregate expected and completed patrols by the original appointed subject. Role assignments show the post; shared counts are not split by actual executor.

Patrol.replaceRosterConfirm: Replace all rosters for {month} in this application?
Patrol.imported: Imported {count} rosters. View them in the calendar.
Patrol.rosterTemplateHint: Maintain patrol posts and members before downloading. Fill shift names and times in the shifts sheet, then enter shift names or 休息 starting at row 6. Post and user IDs are authoritative. Import replaces the entire application month.

ruleEditor.weekHint: Each weekday belongs to one rule; periods must not overlap
ruleEditor.dateHint: This date uses this rule instead of its weekday rule
ruleEditor.addDate: Add date (configure a rule for a specific date)

errors.empty: Configure at least one weekday rule or date rule
errors.days: Select at least one weekday for rule {index}
errors.periods: Add at least one period to rule {index}
errors.number: Frequency, count and interval must be integers from 1 to 100
errors.capacity: A period must not exceed 10000 patrols and must accommodate its frequency and minimum interval
errors.duplicateDay: A weekday can belong to only one rule
errors.date: Select a valid date for every date rule
errors.datePeriods: Add at least one period for {date}
errors.overlap: Patrol periods overlap; check overnight periods on the previous day too
errors.limit: At most 24 periods per rule and 366 date rules are allowed

Patrol.warningSettingsHint: Configure abnormal triggers, warning codes and display colors.
Patrol.selectCategory: Select a category on the left

missed.title: Missed inspections
missed.reasonRequired: Enter a reason or rejection note, up to 500 characters
missed.approveHint: Approval credits the selected missed occurrences and preserves the review record.
missed.loadFailed: Could not load missed inspections. Retry.
missed.empty: No missed occurrences in this range
missed.range: Select a range of up to 31 days
missed.actionFailed: The action failed. Refresh and retry.

Patrol.assignmentPostsDiffer: Assign the same posts to all selected points before configuring rules
Patrol.assignmentPostsHelp: Post members can view and perform point tasks. Saving replaces the selected points’ posts, keeps retained posts’ rules, and leaves new posts unconfigured.
Patrol.assignmentLimit: Select at most 100 points and 20 posts per operation

configDelete.confirm: Delete this configuration? Referenced point-post rules must be updated first.
configDelete.failed: Deletion failed. Check the error and try again.

Patrol.creator: Created by

pointCategories.linkHelp: Link these points to another category while keeping existing categories and patrol records.
pointCategories.cancelHelp: Remove only the selected category association and its post rules. Keep the physical points and historical patrol records.
pointCategories.noCommon: These points have no category in common. Select points from the same category.
pointCategories.choose: Select the category for this operation.
